name: Kurobe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kurobe city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green mountains above dark green and blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kurobe, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 31 March 2006.

features.role: Kurobe city emblem — a disc of green mountains above dark green and blue curved strokes
